details.description:
In our lifetime, we tend to grow & develop the most during our childhood years. These early years are responsible for the bones lengthening, the muscles becoming sturdy, sense organs getting strong and the brain growing rapidly. With so many activities going on during childhood, the baby must have sufficient care & maintenance.
This can happen in two ways –
A healthy and nutritious food that facilitates healthy metabolism.
Care of the body through Oil massage. 
The traditional practice of Shishu Abhyanga done to babies is very much under the principles of Ayurveda. Shishu Abhyanga is a massage that's done with warm oil. The oil is applied to the entire body, from the scalp to the soles of the baby's feet. To make this traditional and enriching experience a beautiful bonding moment between a mother & a child, we from the house of Parachute, bring to you Coco Soul Baby Massage Oil with Extra Virgin Coconut oil & Ayurvedic Herbs. Enriched with Virgin Coconut Oil, Wheatgerm Oil, Shea Butter, Rosehip Oil & flaxseed oil, this product can help promote the overall growth of the child. Extra virgin coconut oil, which is rich in lauric acid, not only makes the baby's skin soft but also smooth & supple. Indulge in the practice of Shishu Abhyanga with your baby, for smooth, soft & supple skin while promoting wholesome growth.
details.usageInstructions:
Apply the Cocosoul Baby Massage oil from the head to the baby's feet.
Using soft pressure, apply the oil in a circular motion to gently stimulate the baby's skin.
Traditionally, Shishu Abhyanga can be practised in the morning or evening.
